review:
A fan favourite returns with a choose-your-bonus round. Three scatters activate it, and you pick from seven options combining up to 20 free spins with starting wild multipliers up to 15x.

Every win with a wild raises the wild multiplier by its starting value, and extra spins can drop in at random. Super scatters can trigger Super Free Spins, which start with the full 20 spins and a 15x wild. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
